standard.summary: 将冻结的 Linear/Conv 模块整体驻留在 CPU，只在 forward 时按需搬到 GPU。
standard.effect: 可节省大量冻结权重显存，但增加 CPU↔GPU 搬运时间。profile 控制激进程度。
standard.whenToUse: 极小显存（8GB 以下）运行大模型时的最后手段；low_vram_profile 会自动启用。
standard.avoidWhen: 16GB 以上显存通常不需要；搬运开销可能使训练慢 3-5 倍。

standard_en.summary: Keeps the frozen Linear/Conv modules resident on the CPU as a whole and moves them to the GPU on demand during the forward pass.
standard_en.effect: It can save a great deal of VRAM on frozen weights, at the cost of CPU<->GPU transfer time. profile controls how aggressive it is.
standard_en.whenToUse: The last resort for running a large model on very little VRAM (under 8GB); low_vram_profile enables it automatically.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Usually unnecessary above 16GB; the transfer overhead can make training 3-5 times slower.

advanced.principle: 与 block swap 不同，module offload 将整个 module（包含所有子参数）作为一个搬运单元。module_offload_ratio 控制多少比例的模块被 offload（0-100%）。profile 预设：conservative 只 offload 最大的几个层，aggressive 几乎 offload 所有冻结层。
advanced.intervention: 替换 nn.Module 的 forward，在调用前执行 .to(device) 并在之后执行 .to('cpu')。
advanced.expectedImpact: 冻结权重显存趋近于零；但训练速度随 offload 比例线性下降。
advanced.tradeoffs: prefetch_enabled 异步预取下一个 module 以重叠搬运和计算；include/exclude_patterns 精细控制哪些层参与 offload。

advanced_en.principle: Unlike block swap, module offload treats the entire module (all sub-parameters included) as one transfer unit. module_offload_ratio controls what fraction of modules get offloaded (0-100%). Profile presets: conservative offloads only the largest few layers; aggressive offloads nearly all frozen layers.
advanced_en.intervention: Replaces the nn.Module's forward, running .to(device) before the call and .to('cpu') after.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Frozen-weight VRAM approaches zero; training speed drops roughly linearly with offload ratio.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: prefetch_enabled asynchronously prefetches the next module, overlapping transfer with compute; include/exclude_patterns finely control which layers participate.
